slug: home-page-entry-point
title: Make the home page a real entry point into the data
type: Feature
milestone: Phase 2 — Coverage & polish
labels: ["area:frontend", "size:M"]
priority: P1
status: Ready
---

**As** a first-time visitor
**I want** the home page to get me into the events
**so that** I do not have to work out where the product is.

Today the home page describes the site. The data is one navigation step away, and a first-time
visitor who does not take that step never sees the thing that would make them stay.

**Candidates:** a prominent "Browse events" link, tonight's events inline, or filtering and searching
directly from the home page.

Worth pairing with the branding and UX passes rather than doing in isolation — this is the page
those passes will most want to change.
